Who We are
Home
Who We Are
Market Cloud helps companies to run and optimize Complex Business functions and
Deliver Sustainable Outcomes
Market Cloud delivers Digital transformation services to Clients to become innovative, faster and more agile by delivering solutions using cutting edge technologies such as SAP S/4 HANA, Azure, AWS, GCP, Big data, Analytics, AI/ML, Data Science and Full stack applications.
Market Cloud is specialized in Enterprise Consulting, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, IT Outsourcing, Tech Resourcing serving customers across UK, Europe, US, Canada, Middle East and India.
We partner with businesses of all sizes and across industries to help them achieve their unique goals and navigate the ever-evolving digital landscape.
We are driven by Innovation, Simplified solution and better User experience.
In order to be the leading professional services firm it’s important we have the right values, culture and behaviours embedded throughout our organization, so our work reflects our purpose and we can successfully deliver our strategy.
Mission
We empower clients to maximize the power of their IT and business strategies, driving growth and success in the digital platform.
Vision
We aspire to be the trusted architect and integrator of next-generation IT solutions, delivering exceptional value through constant innovation, agility, and unwavering excellence.
Our Purpose
We are a diverse IT Consulting and Professional services business, bound together by our purpose – to build trust in society and solve important problems for our clients and the communities in which we operate.
We believe we can make the biggest impact when our purpose is embedded within everything we do.
Our Values define who we are
Our employees come from different backgrounds and cultures, our values are what we make in common.
Our values hold us accountable to be the best we can be, to act with integrity and to take personal responsibility for our actions.
The work that we do makes a difference and through working together we can reimagine the possible.
We bring value in the work we deliver and care for our clients, our communities and each other.
Leadership with Trust
Encourage people to step up and take initiative, challenging the status and embracing new ideas and build trust
Integrity
Emphasize doing the right thing and upholding ethical standards in all aspects of their work.
Growth Mindset
To increase our impact on more young people through dedication, innovation, training and hard work
Customer Centric Approach
Prioritizes customers' needs, expectations and delivery Products & Services
Our Culture
Our culture is one of inclusivity and care, where we respect each other and our differences. It’s one that supports collaboration, teamwork and innovation and one that embraces difference.
We support everyone having a voice and feeling empowered to bringing new ideas to the table.
Together we create an environment where our people can bring their values to work, where everyone feels welcome, safe and secure and where they are empowered to be the best they can be.
Our Commitment
In line with the EU objectives commitment, Market Cloud is committed to achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions across all areas of our operations emissions by 2050.
Climate change mitigation
Climate change adaptation
Protection and restoration of biodiversity and ecosystems
Pollution prevention and control
Sustainable use and protection of water and marine resources
Transition to a circular economy
Why us
Expertise in Cutting-Edge Technologies
At MarketCloud, we focus on using cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence, big data, and data science to deliver solutions. This can give you a competitive advantage by leveraging the latest technological advancements.
Our specialization in Various Services
We offer a comprehensive suite of services, including analytics, artificial intelligence, sourcing, SAP consulting, and support. This all-in-one approach simplifies your operations, making it easier to manage your IT needs.
Global Reach
With a presence in the UK, Europe, Middle East, US, Canada, and India, we can provide support and expertise no matter where you are located.
Trusted Partner
Our focus is on helping clients achieve their goals. We work closely with you to understand your specific needs and develop solutions tailored to your business. We work with businesses of all sizes and industries to achieve their unique goals.
